summary: Redirect to the downloadable album file URL
description: Returns an HTTP redirect to the requested album file. The request must include a valid client_id and an album id. The optional audioformat parameter selects the audio encoding (currently only mp3). Starting April 2022, a 404 error is returned if the album's 'zip_allowed' flag is false. This endpoint does not inherit the usual parent parameter declarations and returns no JSON body, only a redirect response.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: The audio format for the file URL. Currently only 'mp3' (192kbps) is supported.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Album identifier for which the file should be downloaded.

notes: The response is an HTTP 302 redirect to the actual file URL; no JSON payload is returned.
'zip_allowed' flag is now included in other album endpoints; if false, this endpoint will return a 404.
Ensure your application follows redirects to obtain the file.
